SOLAR ENERGY SYSTEM REGULATIONS
Chapter 12: Solar Development and Permitting

Solar Ordinance Purpose
This ordinance establishes standards for solar energy system development to promote
renewable energy while protecting community aesthetics and environment.

Solar System Types
1. Rooftop Solar: Photovoltaic or thermal systems on building roofs
2. Ground-Mounted Solar: Arrays on undeveloped land
3. Utility-Scale Solar: Commercial facilities generating power for grid

Solar Permit Requirements
All solar installations >5 kW require a solar energy permit from the planning department.
Solar permits must be issued within 30 days of complete application.

Building-Integrated Photovoltaics (BIPV)
Solar systems integrated into building materials and structures are permitted
on residential properties without separate solar permitting in some cases.

Design Standards for Solar Arrays
- Setback requirements: minimum 10 feet from property lines
- Height restrictions: 20 feet maximum for ground-mounted systems
- Color specifications: Non-reflective surfaces required

Interconnection Standards
All solar systems must comply with solar interconnection standards and local utility
requirements for grid connection and solar net metering agreements.
